experiment: MM1 — multimodal cue amplification on the frozen wave-computer core
status: pre-registered before running mm1_run.py (an exploratory run on seeds 1000-3019 motivated it; those seeds are excluded)
question: In the phase-coded associative core, does recall rise when several sensory cues from the SAME episode are combined (constructive superposition), and fall when cues come from DIFFERENT episodes (destructive superposition)?
model: repro/wave-computer/repro/wave_compute_core.py, unmodified: hebbian_field, pattern_to_phase, relax(steps=600, dt=0.05), overlap

setup.incoherent_condition: block m cued from episode m (m = 0..k-1)
setup.seeds: numpy default_rng(5000 + s), s = 0..39 (40 fresh seeds)

predictions.P1_amplification: coherent recall rate is non-decreasing in k = 1..4, and rate(k=4) - rate(k=1) >= 0.40
